entities.name: PMID:10727546
observations: 2000 study in six non-diabetic chronic dialysis patients; 48 post-dilution HDF sessions using 1.8 m² polysulfone dialyzers; compared 24 sessions with continuous D50% at 40 mL/h versus 24 without.

entities.name: Glucose increases HDF Kuf
observations: In the 2000 study, D50% infusion increased Kuf from 22.8±2.2 to 32.1±3.9 mL/h/mmHg (P<0.0001); urea reduction rose 75±5% to 79±4%, creatinine reduction 68±4% to 74±10%, and double-pool Kt/V 1.65±0.24 to 1.86±0.24 (P<0.005). No detrimental effects were observed during the sessions; six-patient study, limited evidence.
